messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "store between 15°C and 30°C (59°F and 86°F)"
set: ["store between 15°C and 30°C (59°F and 86°F)", "store between 4°C and 30°C (39°F and 86°F)", "store at room temperature between 68°F and 77°F (20°C to 25°C)", "not interchangeable between liquid and tablets", "difference is between safe and dangerous doses", "kept from 8°C to 30°C (46°F to 86°F) for up to 28 days", "store tablets and capsules at room temperature away from moisture and heat", "bottle sizes vary between products and pack sizes", "store at room temperature away from moisture and heat", "store securely out of sight and reach of children", "store in refrigerator between 2°C to 8°C (36°F to 46°F)", "store in refrigerator between 36ºF to 46ºF (2ºC to 8ºC)", "store at room temperature away from moisture and heat and out of reach of children", "for use only at night between 6:30 and 9:30 pm", "store tightly closed at room temperature away from moisture and heat", "do not switch between tablets and oral liquid without doctor changing dose"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
